tables.name: Entities
tables.description: England, the 7 regions and the 120 trusts with a Type 1 department in every month of the SPC window (spc_summary.csv). Variation and assurance come from the Python SPC rules (src/spc.py).

tables.name: Monthly
tables.description: One row per entity per month, 2020 onwards. England and regions count every A&E type; trusts are their Type 1 (major) departments, as in the SPC summary. Combined in Power Query from three CSVs.

tables.name: Calendar
tables.description: One row per month. Month Index counts months from January 2020; In SPC Window = 1 for the last 24 months, the baseline for the process limits.

measures.name: Selected Code
measures.dax: SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[code], "ENG" )
measures.description: The trust, region or England in context; England when nothing (or more than one) is selected.

measures.name: Selected Name
measures.dax: LOOKUPVALUE ( Entities[name], Entities[code], [Selected Code] )
measures.description: Name of the entity in context, for titles.

measures.name: A&E Attendances
measures.dax:
VAR _code = [Selected Code]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( Monthly[attendances] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Entities ), Entities[code] = _code )
measures.description: A&E attendances (England and regions: all types; trusts: Type 1).

measures.name: Waited Over 4 Hours
measures.dax:
VAR _code = [Selected Code]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( Monthly[over_4hrs] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Entities ), Entities[code] = _code )
measures.description: Attendances that took more than 4 hours from arrival to admission, transfer or discharge.

measures.name: % Within 4 Hours
measures.dax: DIVIDE ( [A&E Attendances] - [Waited Over 4 Hours], [A&E Attendances] )
measures.description: Share of attendances seen within 4 hours.

measures.name: Waits Over 12 Hours
measures.dax:
VAR _code = [Selected Code]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( Monthly[dta_12hr_plus] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Entities ), Entities[code] = _code )
measures.description: Patients waiting more than 12 hours from decision to admit to admission.

measures.name: 4-Hour Standard
measures.description: The 4-hour standard used for assurance in this project.

measures.name: Latest Month
measures.dax:
VAR _last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Calendar'[Month Index] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ) )
RETURN CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Calendar'[Month Name] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Month Index] = _last )
measures.description: Latest month in the data.

measures.name: Latest % Within 4 Hours
measures.dax:
VAR _last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Calendar'[Month Index] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ) )
RETURN CALCULATE ( [% Within 4 Hours], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Month Index] = _last )
measures.description: Performance in the latest month.

measures.name: SPC Mean
measures.dax:
VAR _months =
    CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Month Index] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[In SPC Window] = 1 )
VAR _points =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        _months,
        "@v",
            VAR _i = 'Calendar'[Month Index]
            RETURN CALCULATE ( [% Within 4 Hours], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Month Index] = _i )
    )
VAR _mean = AVERAGEX ( _points, [@v] )
RETURN
    IF ( MAX ( 'Calendar'[In SPC Window] ) = 1, _mean )
measures.description: Centre line: mean of the last 24 months. Blank outside the window so the chart draws it only there.

measures.name: SPC Average Moving Range
measures.dax:
VAR _months =
    CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Month Index] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[In SPC Window] = 1 )
VAR _points =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        _months,
        "@v",
            VAR _i = 'Calendar'[Month Index]
            RETURN CALCULATE ( [% Within 4 Hours], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Month Index] = _i )
    )
VAR _first = MINX ( _points, 'Calendar'[Month Index] )
VAR _ranges =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        FILTER ( _points, 'Calendar'[Month Index] > _first ),
        "@mr",
            VAR _i = 'Calendar'[Month Index]
            RETURN ABS ( [@v] - MAXX ( FILTER ( _points, 'Calendar'[Month Index] = _i - 1 ), [@v] ) )
    )
VAR _amr = AVERAGEX ( _ranges, [@mr] )
VAR _screened = AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( _ranges, [@mr] < 3.267 * _amr ), [@mr] )
RETURN
    IF ( MAX ( 'Calendar'[In SPC Window] ) = 1, COALESCE ( _screened, _amr ) )
measures.description: Average month-to-month change. Moving ranges of 3.267 x the average or more are screened out and the average recalculated, as in Making Data Count.

measures.name: SPC Upper Limit
measures.dax: [SPC Mean] + 2.66 * [SPC Average Moving Range]
measures.description: Upper process limit: mean + 2.66 x average moving range.

measures.name: SPC Lower Limit
measures.dax: [SPC Mean] - 2.66 * [SPC Average Moving Range]
measures.description: Lower process limit: mean - 2.66 x average moving range.

measures.name: Assurance (DAX)
measures.dax:
VAR _upl = [SPC Upper Limit]
VAR _lpl = [SPC Lower Limit]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( _upl ), BLANK (),
        [4-Hour Standard] > _upl, "Will consistently miss",
        [4-Hour Standard] < _lpl, "Will consistently meet",
        "Hit and miss"
    )
measures.description: Where the standard sits against the DAX process limits. Should agree with the Python assurance.

measures.name: Latest Variation
measures.dax: LOOKUPVALUE ( Entities[Variation], Entities[code], [Selected Code] )
measures.description: Latest-month variation from the Python SPC rules (single point, trend, two-of-three, shift).

measures.name: Assurance Rating
measures.dax: LOOKUPVALUE ( Entities[Assurance], Entities[code], [Selected Code] )
measures.description: Assurance against the standard from the Python SPC rules.

measures.name: Trust Latest %
measures.dax: IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[level] ) = "Trust", [Latest % Within 4 Hours] )
measures.description: Latest performance, trusts only (blank for England and regions, so tables list trusts).

measures.name: Trust SPC Mean
measures.dax: IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[level] ) = "Trust", CALCULATE ( [SPC Mean], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ) ) )
measures.description: SPC centre line, trusts only.

measures.name: Trust Lower Limit
measures.dax: IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[level] ) = "Trust", CALCULATE ( [SPC Lower Limit], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ) ) )
measures.description: Lower process limit, trusts only.

measures.name: Trust Upper Limit
measures.dax: IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[level] ) = "Trust", CALCULATE ( [SPC Upper Limit], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ) ) )
measures.description: Upper process limit, trusts only.

measures.name: Region Latest %
measures.dax: IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Entities[level] ) = "Region", [Latest % Within 4 Hours] )
measures.description: Latest performance, regions only.

measures.name: Trusts Consistently Missing
measures.dax: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( Entities ), Entities[level] = "Trust" && Entities[pct_4hr_assurance] = "fail" ) )
measures.description: Trusts whose process limits sit wholly below the standard.

measures.name: Trusts Improving
measures.dax: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( Entities ), Entities[level] = "Trust" && Entities[pct_4hr_variation] = "improvement" ) )
measures.description: Trusts showing special cause improvement in the latest month.

measures.name: Trusts of Concern
measures.dax: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( Entities ), Entities[level] = "Trust" && Entities[pct_4hr_variation] = "concern" ) )
measures.description: Trusts showing special cause concern in the latest month.
